metadata.description: Offline CITES & Wildlife Protection Act 1972 database for Ayurvedic botanicals
metadata.source: CITES Species+ / UNEP-WCMC / MoEFCC India Schedule VI

protected_species.legal_status: Strictly banned for commercial export of wild-harvested specimens. Cultivation requires state license under Biological Diversity Act 2002.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Classical Pratinidhi Dravya with matching Tikta Rasa, Ushna Veerya, Katu Vipaka. Indicated for Kasa, Shwasa, Hikka — same therapeutic Karma as Kushta.
pratinidhi_dravya.pharmacopoeia_reference: Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) Part I, Vol. IV

protected_species.legal_status: Restricted trade under CITES Export Permit & DGFT Certificate of Origin. Only plantation-harvested wood with CITES-NDF certification is exportable.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Classical Pratinidhi Dravya for Rakta Chandana with matching Tikta-Madhura Rasa, Sheeta Veerya. Used as wound-healing and Raktapitta agent.

protected_species.legal_status: Requires Non-Detriment Finding (NDF) certificate and sustainable harvest licensing from State Forest Department.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Pharmacologically validated substitute with matching Tikta Rasa, Ushna Veerya. Sedative and anxiolytic activity comparable to Jatamansi.
pratinidhi_dravya.pharmacopoeia_reference: Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) Part I, Vol. I

protected_species.legal_status: Requires CITES Appendix II Export Permit and Biodiversity Board approval. Reserpine content makes it a scheduled pharmaceutical.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Alternative for neurological indications. Anxiolytic and blood pressure-modulating properties documented in pharmacological studies.

protected_species.legal_status: Strict export quotas apply under CITES Appendix II. Plantation certification required.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Aromatic substitute with Sheeta Veerya used in similar formulations for Daha, Raktapitta, and topical applications.
pratinidhi_dravya.pharmacopoeia_reference: Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) Part I, Vol. I

protected_species.wildlife_act_schedule: Not listed, but State-level bans in Kerala/Karnataka
protected_species.legal_status: Critically endangered in Western Ghats. Harvest restricted by Kerala and Karnataka State biodiversity boards.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Contains identical berberine alkaloid profile. Direct pharmacological and Ayurvedic substitute.

protected_species.legal_status: Wild harvest banned in Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand. Only plantation material with state traceability certificate is tradeable.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Shared bitter tonic activity, Jwarahara (antipyretic) and Deepana (carminative) Karma. Used in same formulation class.

protected_species.legal_status: All wild orchid trade banned under CITES. No legitimate commercial supply chain for wild-sourced tubers.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Cultivated Vajikarana (aphrodisiac) substitute with comparable saponin content and Shukrala activity.
pratinidhi_dravya.pharmacopoeia_reference: Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) Part I, Vol. V

protected_species.legal_status: Requires CITES Appendix II permit. Cultivated material from registered nurseries is trade-eligible.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Tikta Rasa bitter hepatoprotective herb with similar Pitta-shamaka and Yakrit-uttejaka (hepatostimulant) activity.

protected_species.legal_status: Source of taxol (Paclitaxel). Wild harvest strictly banned. Only plantation-derived bark extracts permissible.

pratinidhi_dravya.justification: Classical Pratinidhi for Talispatra in respiratory formulations. Kasa-Shwasa indications shared.
